title: READsparrow v0.13.0: supplied-adapter and anchor-bounded CRISPR guide counting
description: Stable counting/QC release with two explicit exact-spacer workflows: anchor-bounded count and full supplied-adapter count-flex. Count-flex allows up to two adapter edits, requires an exact spacer match and does not require a downstream anchor. The archive includes Python/Pandas APIs, descriptive QC, synthetic examples with independently specified expected counts, regression tests, an environment lock and reproduction commands. Legacy statistical hit calling remains experimental; this release makes no biological FDR certification claim.
